row.team_price_text: Startup: starts at $279 for 2,000 MTUs (MTU-priced, up to 6 teammates)
row.evidence: Chameleon's pricing table sells SAML 2.0 SSO as an add-on ($400/mo on Pro, $4k/yr on Growth and Enterprise), and its SSO help article says 'You can use multiple providers for SSO / SCIM if needed -- for example Duo for SSO and Okta for provisioning.'
row.notes: New row. Plans are priced by monthly tracked users (MTUs), not seats: Startup from $279 for 2,000 MTUs (up to 6 teammates), Pro from $750/mo for 5k MTUs (monthly billing, 10 seats), Growth from $1,250/mo billed annually (15 seats), Enterprise custom (unlimited seats), so per-user prices are null. SAML SSO is a paid add-on on every plan ($4k/yr; $400/mo on Pro). SCIM is only mentioned inside the SSO add-on docs (provisioning from a provider such as Okta, roles attribute in the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User namespace), so status is gated on the add-on; the docs do not publish a SCIM base URL, token flow or operations, and the setup flow lists identity providers in the Dashboard. Chameleon is not listed in the Okta Integration Network. The public REST API (api.chameleon.io, X-Account-Secret) covers end-user profiles, not teammates.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Up to 6 teammates. SSO (and SCIM) only via the paid SSO add-on.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited seats; Roles & Permissions; SAML 2.0 SSO add-on $4k/yr.

roles.how: Custom 'roles' attribute (comma-separated, e.g. admin, viewer, team_creator,team_publisher) mapped in the IdP, namespace urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User; full Roles need Enterprise or RBAC access

limitations.text: No public SCIM reference: base URL, auth, endpoints and operations are not documented; setup instructions appear in the Dashboard after picking a provider.

scim.notes: SCIM appears only as part of the SSO add-on setup (provider picked in the Dashboard). sso_required is set because provisioning is configured through the SSO add-on; the docs do not say whether SCIM can run without SSO login enforced.

limitations.text: REST API 'User Profiles' are the customer's end-users tracked in-product, not Chameleon account teammates.

user_api.notes: Chameleon's REST API (api.chameleon.io, account secret token) manages end-user profiles, companies, Experiences and webhooks; no endpoints for teammates (Chameleon dashboard users) were found in the API reference.

okta.notes: No OIN app; Chameleon's own docs describe connecting Okta for SSO and provisioning through the SSO add-on.

fallbacks.notes: Users who join without an invitation are added as Viewers; whether SSO sign-in creates accounts (JIT) is not stated.
